description:
List groups the caller may assign to a member

Returns the role groups the CURRENT caller is allowed to hand out when creating or re-roling a team member, filtered server-side by the role-assignment ceiling (system groups: at or below the caller's own rank, inclusive; custom groups: only those whose permissions are a subset of the caller's). Build the member-create role dropdown from THIS list — the same rule is enforced on POST/PUT /business/technicians, so anything shown here is guaranteed to be accepted.
name: listAssignableGroups
